caption:
Had knee or hip surgery and wondering where Pilates fits in?

First things first: your surgeon's instructions on weight bearing, movement limits and timelines come before anything else. Clinical Pilates is planned around them.

The reformer suits rehab because springs can take some of your bodyweight, so you can practise squats and bridges with less load, then build up in small steps. Sessions often focus on range of motion, strength, balance and everyday tasks like stairs and getting out of the car. Expect months, not weeks.

Contact your surgeon or GP promptly for wound redness or discharge, fever, calf swelling or sudden breathlessness. Bring your surgeon's notes to your first session with our Pilates team. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
